item.title: 16 More Orange & Purple Cards Revealed: Hela, Silver Surfer, Ronan and More
item.description: Sixteen new Rares from Starter Decks SD05 (Orange) and SD06 (Purple) have been revealed: three Helas, Heimdall, Sif, Silver Surfer, Ronan, Adam Warlock and the Chitauri. Fan-translated card details inside.

item.title: Era of Spiders Arrives in Indonesia as Four Champions Head to Macao
item.description: Era of Spiders (SP01) launched in Indonesia on October 3, and four qualifier winners are flying to Macao for the Asia Peak Invitational at ASCC on October 11.

item.title: Macau Apex Championship Qualifiers: Yogie, Radian and Luthfi Take Batam, Bandung and Surabaya
item.description: Yogie won Batam with Red-Green, while Radian and Luthfi won Bandung and Surabaya with Spider-heavy Red-Blue builds. Top 4 standings and decklist breakdowns from all three Qualifiers.

item.title: Macau Apex Championship Jakarta Qualifier: Red-Blue Took the Entire Top 4
item.description: Edwin's Red-Blue list won the Jakarta Qualifier at Indonesia Comic Con, and all four finalists ran the same Red-Blue shell. Top 4 standings, how each deck was built, and the cards every list agreed on.

item.title: Multiverse Battle September 2026: Red Ran Every Top 8 Deck
item.description: Adzuf's Red-Green list took the trophy at Gramedia World BSD — but the bigger story is that all 8 Top-cut decks played Red. Full standings and decklists inside.

item.title: Comprehensive Rules 1.03: Rulebook Rewritten
item.description: The latest official rules from Jason. The Guide page now has sections on Rarity, Attack Range, and a glossary — plus a Mulligan rule correction.

item.title: News Page Launches on MHR Deck Lab
item.description: Marvel Hero Rush news, cards you can click straight from the article, clean WhatsApp previews, and RSS.

item.title: SP01 "Era of Spiders" Now Uses Official Indonesian Text & Art
item.description: 79 SP01 cards now use official Indonesian effect text, and 114 of its images have been swapped for the Indonesian print versions.

item.title: New Colours: Orange & Purple — SD05, SD06 & PB02 Preview
item.description: Two new colours have officially arrived in Marvel Hero Rush via Starter Decks SD05 and SD06, plus 21 PB02 promo cards. Here are the key cards, with translations.
